title: feat: add Inkling Small
author: ElliotEtag
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds `inkling` with versioned aliases through OpenRouter, pinned to Together with fallback disabled.
- Exposes paid text, image, and audio understanding with tools and reasoning at 0.50/M input, 0.10/M cached input, and 1.20/M output.
- Adds the Thinking Machines brand mark, exact pricing metadata, response framing cleanup, and clear 400 responses for malformed media.
- Verifies direct and local text, reasoning, tools, streaming, image, multi-image, real WAV audio, aliases, cache, errors, usage, wallet deduction, Tinybird billing, and 5/15/30 bursts.
- Passes focused and mandatory suites (481 tests total), both worker typechecks, Biome, and diff checks.

Route limits: Together supports image and audio independently but rejects them together in one request. JSON mode is not advertised. An early direct 30-request probe saw one transient 503; the final local bursts passed 5/5, 15/15, and 30/30.

Sources: https://thinkingmachines.ai/news/introducing-inkling/ · https://thinkingmachines.ai/model-card/inkling/ · https://openrouter.ai/thinkingmachines/inkling-small

gist.headline: A small inkling arrives
gist.blurb: Inkling Small has landed in the hive, with text, vision, audio understanding, tools, and reasoning in one tidy model slot. It brought a Thinking Machines badge and a fairly extensive test entourage.
gist.summary: Added Thinking Machines Inkling Small through OpenRouter, pinned to Together, with versioned aliases and paid text, image, and audio understanding plus tools and reasoning priced at $0.50/M input, $0.10/M cached input, and $1.20/M output tokens.
gist.impact: Developers can call Inkling Small through the text API for streaming, tool use, reasoning, images, multi-image prompts, or WAV audio, with clear malformed-media errors and reliable tested bursts up to 30 requests.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Inkling Small as a cozy little ink bottle or fountain pen beside a retro terminal, with separate picture and WAV sound-wave cards feeding into it to show multimodal understanding. Polli wears tiny round thinker glasses and carefully sorts the cards into separate garden paths, reflecting Together's image-or-audio-per-request route limit; blooming code-plants and the Thinking Machines mark appear nearby.
